_comment: Template for a new flat. Copy to citra_devices.json and edit. BOARDS are the unit - one block per physical switchboard, each with its own host. ROOM is just a label, and several boards can share one: a hall with three switchboards is three blocks that all say "room": "hall", and "turn off the hall" then fans out across all three. Give every board a static IP as a DHCP reservation in the router, never in the firmware.

bed1-fan._note: A 1-channel module is enough for a board that only carries a fan - about 110 rupees cheaper than a 4-channel.

hall-fans._note: Second board in the same room. Same "room" value, different host - that is the whole trick.

_power_note: Every relay coil draws ~71mA and NC wiring keeps a relay energised whenever its light is OFF, so worst case is the normal case. A 4-channel board is 364mA and an HLK-PM01 (600mA) carries it comfortably. An 8-channel board is 648mA and will BROWN OUT on a PM01 - use an HLK-5M05 (1A) there.
